title: Delicious Chicken Pilaf
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make dish that combines chicken with pilaf. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of oil and cook the chicken until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add the pilaf to the skillet and stir to combine with the chicken.
Add 2 cups of water to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the jeweled rice and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with crunchy fried onions.
